note: What a server sends to say one unit hurt another. The header names the unit hurt, as target does.

fields.name: result
fields.note: How the damage landed, and so what a client shows over the unit hurt, as one whole byte. 4 shows the amount, 3 shows it as a critical strike, and 2 shows the word for a dodge in place of an amount; any value above 5 shows as 4.

0.name: invulnerable
0.note: A notice, no number, shown on every thirtieth such message a client receives, across all units.

fields.name: source
fields.note: The unit dealing it. A client shows nothing, notices included, unless it holds target and target can be attacked; it does not need to hold source, and a champion source has the amount added to its damage dealt.

revisions.note: For results 3, 4 and any above 5, a client takes amount off the target's health, held at its maximum, but leaves the health as it was where the new value would be zero or less. Where the header names the client's own champion and the target is a champion, an amount above zero can bring up the low-health screen effect.

5.name: miss
5.note: A notice in the dodge style.

bits.name: sound
